title: Low degree projection moment bounds
statement: Let $g:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $k\in\mathbb N$, and let $q>1$. The Fourier truncation $g^{\leq k}=\sum_{|S|\leq k}\widehat g(S)\chi_S$ satisfies both conditional bounds: if $q\geq2$, then $\|g^{\leq k}\|_q\leq(\sqrt{q-1})^k\|g\|_q$; if $q\leq2$, then $\|g^{\leq k}\|_q\leq(1/\sqrt{q-1})^k\|g\|_q$, with norms taken under the uniform measure on the Boolean cube.
hypotheses_covered: The first bound is asserted under $q\geq2$
The second bound is asserted under $q\leq2$
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube, $k\in\mathbb N$, and $q>1$. The Fourier projection $f^{\le k}$ satisfies $\|f^{\le k}\|_q\le(\sqrt{q-1})^k\|f\|_q$ when $q\ge2$, and $\|f^{\le k}\|_q\le(1/\sqrt{q-1})^k\|f\|_q$ when $q\le2$. For a real function $h$ on the cube, use $\chi_S(x)=\prod_{i\in S}(-1)^{x_i}$, $\widehat h(S)=\mathbb E_x[h(x)\chi_S(x)]$, $h^{\le k}=\sum_{|S|\le k}\widehat h(S)\chi_S$, $\|h\|_p=(\mathbb E_x|h(x)|^p)^{1/p}$, with uniform expectation $\mathbb E_x$ and natural powers $0^0=1$.
